rules: PUT article and POST approval require positive safe integer expectedVersion;invalid/missing =>400.
Version compare/current article read/write happen in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction;mismatch =>409 before article/case/event changes.
Edit increments content version and resets approval;approval requires the version displayed in its originating list.
After conflict old form input remains visible;return/refresh and reconcile deliberately. No automatic merge.
Direct in-process KnowledgeDesk callers retain optional version precondition for compatibility;HTTP clients cannot omit it.
limits: Version token protects content edits;approval itself does not increment content version. Reapproval of the same content remains possible.
No immutable complete article revision archive added;existing case source snapshots retained.
Old cached clients must reload to send expectedVersion. No server/cloud/CRM/WhatsApp integrations or customer acceptance added.
